gen-dafont-quantum-gf-marcellus-sc: Loose, clean and techy: Quantum gives every letter breathing space, with compact ascenders and open mouths. Marcellus SC, a serif with gentle stroke shifts and sturdy lowercase, brings a dignified, literary pace to paragraphs.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-noto-serif-hentaig: Quantum draws its heading in a smooth, wire-like line, loosely spaced and clean, with ascenders cut short and mouths left open. Noto Serif Hentaigana then adds refined stroke modulation, so tech meets tradition.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-ovo: Crisp, spacious and a bit futuristic: Quantum lays out unshaded outlines with short ascenders. But where Quantum is best at crisp statement, Ovo's soft thick-thin serif letters do the authoritative talking.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-esteban: Esteban is a serif whose hairlines barely slim down from its stems, and whose e never pinches shut. Esteban keeps a refined, classic poise beneath Redux, the wide-spaced geometric display heading.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-faustina: Redux greets every curve with a big, visible entrance, spacing its geometric letters wide. Faustina steps in with bowls that thin gently and an open-jawed c, giving the heading an authoritative partner.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-halant: Redux spaces its geometric letters wide and gives each curve a big, visible entrance. Halant, a serif with a faint thick-thin shift and outward-pointing terminals, makes extended reading feel sturdy and traditional.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-hedvig-letters-serif: Redux spreads wide, geometric letters with generous curve entrances. Hedvig Letters Serif adds the authority, with open-ended curves, a sturdy lowercase body and medium contrast that never feels cramped.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-lisu-bosa: Wide letter spacing and big, visible curve entrances give Redux a geometric, contemporary stance. Lisu Bosa, a serif with spill-out counters and lightly flexed contrast, backs it up with large, sturdy words.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-montagu-slab: Redux wears a big, visible entrance on every curved letter. Use it big and brief, then let Montagu Slab, a serif with robust downstrokes and slender turns, carry the rest.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-serif-hentaigan: Contemporary and geometric, Redux spaces its letters wide, while Noto Serif Hentaigana brings refined, traditional modulation to the body. Its open-jawed curves and subtle stroke modulation make extended reading flow gently.
